Who I Am

Curious mind.
Relentless builder.

I'm Angel Sharon, a artificial intelligence and data science Engineering student at Karunya University pass out expected- 2028, Coimbatore. I specialize in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Computer Networks — building systems that solve real-world problems with technical precision and visual impact.

My work spans across AI-powered stress monitoring, predictive energy management, epidemic detection, TCP/UDP networking, biometric VR classrooms, data governance, and AI-curated knowledge preservation — each project pushing the envelope of what student engineering can achieve.

I believe in building things that are both technically sound and visually compelling. Code is craft. Systems are art. Every project I ship tells a story.

⭐ Flagship Project
VR · AI · Biometrics
NeuroVerse — AI Biometric Adaptive VR Classroom

A smart VR-based classroom where wearable sensors (heart rate, skin conductance, temperature) feed into a trained Random Forest classifier to detect student states — Focused, Confused, Overloaded — and dynamically adapt the virtual environment in real-time. Features three adaptive modes: MorphWorld, CollabSphere, and ZenMode.

ML · Public Health
Epidemic Outbreak Early Warning System

Generated 3,000 synthetic records using Faker (date, location, disease, cases, deaths, environmental & social data). Trains a Random Forest Classifier — records with outbreak probability >0.7 flagged as high-risk. Folium map visualizes hotspots with probability-scaled circles.

DualStream Chat — TCP/UDP Networking App

Full-stack Python networking project featuring TCP reliable chat (port 9999), UDP broadcast messaging (port 9998), and multi-room group chat (port 8888). Demonstrates real-time socket programming, multi-threading, and protocol trade-offs in a live interactive dashboard.
